title: Support Surgical Kiosk: Autopilot microflows & safe shortcuts
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Build a lightweight 'Surgical Kiosk' service: a curated set of idempotent microflows and one-click shortcuts for common incident remediation steps. The kiosk aims to reduce MTTR for frequent support tasks while preserving safety via permission gates, dry-run mode, audit trails, and automated telemetry. It should integrate with existing runbook-as-code snippets, expose a guarded HTTP surface for the Console and ChatOps, and provide replay/dry-run and post-action telemetry for regression detection.
acceptance_criteria: Core kiosk service implements 5 microflows (cache-warm, prefix-kv-refresh, small-rollback, restart-idempotent, circuit-reset) with idempotency guarantees
Each microflow supports dry-run and audit log entry to tenant audit storage
Console UI exposes the kiosk with RBAC checks and two-step confirmation for high-risk flows
Telemetry hooks emit action, outcome, latency, and token-cost dimensions to Grafana/Datadog dashboards
A canary rollout plan and automatic fallback policy are documented and validated via synthetic tests
engineering_notes: 2026-03-02: Spike complete — evaluated two execution models: (A) agent-side isolated sandbox, (B) runtime-hooked synchronous microflows. Chose (A) for stronger isolation and simpler permissioning.
2026-03-04: Prototype implements dry-run by materializing a delta-plan and validating side effects without committing. Verified with local integration against staging-kv cluster.

2026-03-06: Trade-off discussion: synchronous vs async. Opting for hybrid: blocking for quick low-risk flows, async for long-running remediate steps with status polling. This keeps latency SLOs for Console UX.
2026-03-07: Security review kickoff scheduled; kiosk service will call into existing KMS-backed admin API; added mandatory scoped API keys and ephemeral session tokens for operator actions.
2026-03-08: PR opened with initial microflows and test harness: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ops-kiosk/pull/45 — needs load tests and e2e gating.
2026-03-09: Telemetry schema agreed: action_type, flow_id, user_id, outcome, start_ts, end_ts, estimated_token_cost. Dashboard query draft: grafana/internal/dashboard/d/ops-kiosk-actions
Next steps: finish RBAC checks, add automated dry-run verification in CI, instrument synthetic canary that replays a safe microflow against staging every 4h.
